svg.text: Oxford NPG80 blind conditional profile atlas
All 56 frozen endpoints · same physical scale in every panel · no target SEM or target depth used
Filled blue: 1200 s endpoint. Orange outline: last pre-clear geometry; reported depth is film-capped at 700 nm.
Geometry is conditional on a cross-machine blanket-rate interval and inferred IADF; Cr is pinned and passivation/charging/redeposition are omitted.
